## Requirements
1. Tier-token curator store productionized: issue/invite-based, pseudonymous, NOT open signup; anti-poisoning + append-only actor id intact; secrets env-only (HG-09); curation authenticated, not public, loopback.
2. Corrections/dispute ops: anonymous no-account `/dispute` intake wired to append-only correction claims + takedown/corrections operator runbook (§36).
3. OSM contribution-back live (HG-08): MapRoulette + OSM changeset feed → LeverageLedger, activation-ready; real push only if key present AND registered, else RETURN PASS advancing D-P21.7-1.
4. Cite ADR-100 (seeded); open/keep D-R7.1-AUTH. No homegrown account/credential system.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1 issue/invite-based + pseudonymous tier-token store (no open signup); curation authenticated/not-public/loopback; append-only with actor id — deterministic.
- AC2 corrections/dispute intake + takedown runbook land; OSM contribution-back loop runs live → LeverageLedger — deterministic + live-gated.
- AC3 ADR-R6-IDENTITY (=ADR-100) cited; D-R7.1-AUTH opened; NO homegrown account/credential system — deterministic.
- AC4 `make check` + build-memory green — deterministic.

## Evidence report

### Acceptance criteria → evidence
- **AC1 — tier-token store issue/invite-based + pseudonymous (no open signup); curation authenticated/not-public/loopback; append-only actor id** — MET. `api/src/api/tier_tokens.py` (`Invite`/`INVITES`/`TierTokenStore`/`load_tier_token_store`); a token authenticates only when its handle is both invited (committed registry) AND env-provisioned; non-invited token ignored, revoked invite never resolves. Live-verified: a provisioned `SIG_CURATION_TOKEN_SIG_CURATOR` token → 200; the demo token is inert (401) once a real token is provisioned; root discloses `token_store: provisioned`. `tests/api/test_tier_tokens.py` (9). Curation unchanged: `authenticated_contributor` 401/403, `SIG_CURATION_ENABLED` disabled-by-default, `serve-curation --host 127.0.0.1`; `tests/api/test_curation.py` green; `CurationLog.append` refuses empty actor.
- **AC2 — corrections/dispute intake + takedown runbook; OSM contribution-back → LeverageLedger** — MET (live-gated). `policy/src/policy/corrections_intake.py` wires `correct` → `BeliefLog.correct` (append-only; prior value resolves at its belief-time); `tests/unit/test_corrections_intake.py` (10). Runbook `docs/build/reports/CORRECTIONS_TAKEDOWN_RUNBOOK.md` + `sig-policy corrections` CLI. Contribution-back: `HttpxMapRouletteTransport` wired into the CLI (activation-ready); live-verified `maproulette push --dry-run` → REFUSED exit 3 while `registered=false`; `osm-feed pull` → 4 attributed / 3 §7 accepted, no OSM display names; `tests/tasks/test_maproulette_live_transport.py` (4) proves the live POST shape via `httpx.MockTransport` (no socket). HG-08 key `provided:no` → real push is RETURN PASS advancing D-P21.7-1.
- **AC3 — ADR-R6-IDENTITY cited; D-R7.1-AUTH opened; NO homegrown accounts** — MET. ADR-100 cited throughout (no dup, has `## Revisit trigger`); D-R7.1-AUTH present + OPEN in DEFERRALS; no password/username/signup path added.
- **AC4 — `make check` + build-memory green** — MET. `make check` exit 0 (3746 passed / 3 skipped; lint+format+mypy+verify-gen clean); `check-build-memory.sh .` exit 0 (1 pre-existing BM-ADR-04 warning); `check_backlog`/`build_backlog_md --check`/`check_spec_src`/`test_policy_adrs` (102)/`make docs-check` exit 0.

### Gap analysis
First implementation covered all deliverables; the gap walk (re-reading the ticket + §3/§5 design + ADR-100) found the design's core assets already built (MapRoulette registration gate, sensitive-tier exclusion, OSM no-names, `BeliefLog`, anti-poisoning), so the work was the three genuine gaps: (1) the demo `CURATION_KEYS` → real invite/env store; (2) the intake ops loop + runbook; (3) the missing concrete MapRoulette transport (client raised "none wired" even with a key). No scope creep: no P29.2/P29.3 or OAuth code.
